events.name: Bash
events.head: Check origin/main and mirror repo commits
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git fetch -q origin 2>&1|tail -2; git log -1 --format='%h %ci' origin/main; git merge-base --is-ancestor 757b2ecd origin/main && echo 757-in-main; ls live 2>/dev/null|head; cd live 2>/dev/null && git fetch -q && git log -3 --format='%h %ci %s' origin/HEAD | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: Mirror log and app changes since last publish
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/live; git branch -r|head -3; git log -3 --format='%h %ci %s' origin/main 2>/dev/null| cut -c1-160; cd ..; git log --oneline 41b1fcac..origin/main -- app/ | head -20; git diff --stat 41b1fcac origin/main -- app/src app/public | tail -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Latest site publishes on mirror
events.input: $ cd live; git log -5 --format='%h %ci %s' origin/main -- site | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: Grep live mirror pages and compare share metadata
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; for p in masterclass vip; do curl -s "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/$p/?v=$(date +%s)" -o /tmp/t001-$p.html; echo "$p: 50M=$(grep -o '\$50M' /tmp/t001-$p.html|wc -l) refund=$(grep -oi 'refund\|money-back' /tmp/t001-$p.html|wc -l) webinar=$(grep -oi webinar /tmp/t001-$p.html|wc -l) keep=$(grep -o 'What you keep' /tmp/t001-$p.html|wc -l) price99=$(grep -o '\$99' /tmp/t001-$p.html|wc -l)"; done; grep -o '<meta property="og:title" content="[^"]*"' /tmp/t001-masterclass.html; grep -o '<meta property="og:description" content="[^"]*"' /

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show webinar contexts on live masterclass

events.text: Live mirror matches main (no $50M, no refund, share card correct). Now running both probes against the mirror.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run probe-funnels and probe-workshop on mirror
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; export BASE=https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site PREFIX=/; (node scripts/probe-funnels.mjs 2>&1 | tail -15) ; echo ======; node scripts/probe-workshop.mjs 2>&1 | grep -iE 'fail|✗|pass|ok:|total|summary' | tail -8

events.name: Bash
events.head: Confirm widths and run probe-workshop
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; grep -n '390\|1440' scripts/probe-funnels.mjs | head -5; BASE=https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site PREFIX=/ node scripts/probe-workshop.mjs > /tmp/t001-pw.txt 2>&1; echo exit=$?; grep -ciE '^ *(ok|✓|pass)' /tmp/t001-pw.txt; grep -iE 'fail|✗' /tmp/t001-pw.txt | cut -c1-160 | head -8; tail -3 /tmp/t001-pw.txt
